Call Forwarding/diverting
Call divert is a feature that enables you to forward or redirect their incoming calls to an alternate number, which can be a landline or any other Mobile number. When call divert is enabled, the phone does not ring at the original number of the incoming call, but rather only at the locations the call had been diverted to. You can forward calls from your handset to another phone by changing the settings in your existing handset, go to the call management option from your handset settings and activate call forwarding option. This service is absolutely free for all Teletalk users.
